messages:
miguel: quick check — vendor just sent the weekly inventory CSV and it shows a ~22% drop in available H100 slots for eu-west. anyone else seeing a quota cliff in the dashboard?

tess: saw that spike in pending reservations earlier, might be some long-running demos holding slots. can you paste the CSV?

miguel: pasted link -> https://storage.internal/recon/610000/inventory_2026-03-17.csv

anna: looking now. small note: our reserved Dedicated pool for EU is pinned to fleet-group:rd-eu-prod which the vendor labels as frankfurt-2. vendor-ops, did something change on your end?

vendor-ops: vendor-ops: passed along — vendor has a maintenance window 03/17 02:00-06:00 UTC that shifted a subset of H100 nodes to draining; estimated return by 03/18 10:00 UTC. impact: ~18-25% of eu-west H100 capacity until endpoint remediation completes.

eric: thanks. can we get a quick tally of which tenant reservations are affected? I can run a script to identify pinned pools vs ephemeral slots.

miguel: that would help. also need to know if this maintenance will evict Dedicated capacity or only affect ephemeral bursts. vendor-ops?

vendor-ops: maintenance affects host-level nodes; any instance on those racks (both ephemeral and dedicated oversub) may be impacted. however reserved committed capacity (hard SLA boxes) should be prioritized for migration — still ETA for full remediation is the same.

tess: action item — miguel, eric, can you run sweep to mark at-risk reservations and notify product demo owners? Use tag:eu-demo and tag:rd-eu-prod in the scan. quick command: ```python tools/gpu_recon.py --tags eu-demo,rd-eu-prod --since 72h --out at_risk.txt```

miguel: started that now. pinging infra-ops with the at_risk list once done.

eric: ran a quick grep on current leases; ~6 active demo jobs + 2 long-running CI jobs on the affected racks. I'll try to migrate the CI jobs to us-west standby pool if allowed.

anna: we should also consider temporary capacity fallbacks — can we enable L40s autoswap for lower-priority workloads to free H100? cost/perf tradeoff is better than evicting demos.

vendor-ops: we can expose an API toggle for hardware fallback, but it requires a config push. ETA ~45min to roll the toggle across eu region.

tess: ok plan: 1) miguel/eric produce at_risk list, 2) product/demo teams get notified to pause non-critical runs, 3) enable L40s autoswap for any job labeled noncritical, 4) vendor-ops monitor and update when nodes return.

miguel: at_risk.txt uploaded -> https://storage.internal/recon/610000/at_risk.txt. I included owner, reservation_id, pool_tag. Starting owner pings now.

eric: I kicked two CI jobs to us-west standby and verified they passed smoke. left a comment in their PR.

vendor-ops: maintenance patch applied to 60% of affected racks. new ETA for full return 03/18 04:30 UTC. will send another update in 30m or earlier if status changes. :white_check_mark:

anna: thanks all — can we add a postmortem note in the capacity-runbook about better pre-notice validation for vendor windows? I can draft a short blurb.

tess: please do. also flag whether we want automated autoswap for specific labels in future so we don't need manual toggles.

miguel: closing loop — notified owners, set lower-priority jobs to autoswap, and created a follow-up ticket: INFRA-8810 (vendor-maint-fallback-policy). I'll upload meeting notes.

eric: marking thread resolved for now. will reopen if vendor-ops updates ETA.

vendor-ops: update 30m: still patched ~75%, holding to verify synthetic traffic. no regressions so far. next update 03/18 02:00 UTC or earlier.
